summary: Recent developments have intensified focus on federal control over Washington, D.C., with advocates pointing to National Guard deployments and threats of federal takeover as evidence that statehood remains urgent. DC Vote has urged lawmakers to reject what it characterizes as attacks on the district's fiscal independence while highlighting federal military presence in the capital as an ongoing demonstration of limited local autonomy.
